_note: Curated. Q (Pierce, KalistaMysticShotAbility): TotalDamage = BaseDamage + 1.05 total AD, physical, single-target -- matches auto-pick, hand-verified against BIN. E (Rend, KalistaExpungeWrapperAbility/KalistaExpungeWrapper): NormalDamage = BaseDamage + BaseADRatio*totalAD + APRatio*AP, physical -- this is the FIRST spear only; each ADDITIONAL spear stuck in the target uses a separate, smaller 'AdditionalDamage' calc (AdditionalBaseDamage + AdditionalADRatio*totalAD + AdditionalAPRatio*AP) that isn't modeled since the engine has no live count of spears embedded in the target (would require tracking prior Q casts hitting the same target across the whole game) -- curated as a single first-spear hit, a conservative UNDERCOUNT for any Rend after 2+ landed Qs. P (Martial Poise) and W (Sentinel) and R (Fate's Call) confirmed via BIN to carry zero damage calcs (pure utility: attack-speed/move-speed on backspear, vision ally-marker, ally pull+shield) -- correctly no 'hits' entry.
